title: Gideon and the House
author: Q. M. Delacroix
blurb: Zephyrine Lockridge, a pest controller called to something with fingerprints, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. Then the village's church bell rings although the bell was melted down in 1911 — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must return what was taken in 1974 before the frost writes its final pattern.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
